sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Squid Match Game are simple yet addictive. Players are presented with a grid of cards, each featuring a character from the Squid Game series. The player's goal is to match card pairs based on the characters. The game starts with a set of three cards, and the player must match each pair to progress to the next level. As the player progresses through the levels, the number of cards increases, making it more challenging to match the pairs.

One of the key features of Squid Match Game is its use of a timer. The player has a limited amount of time to match each pair, adding an extra layer of challenge to the game. The timer also adds a sense of urgency, making the game more engaging and addictive.

The game also features a variety of power-ups, including a 'shuffle' power-up that randomizes the cards on the grid, and a 'hint' power-up that reveals the location of a pair. These power-ups can be purchased using in-game currency or earned through gameplay.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Squid Match Game are simple yet addictive, making it a great experience for players of all skill levels.
